task_pattern: Paid order remains pending after payment.captured webhook
description: Diagnose order-service incidents where logs show payment.captured delivery but orders stay PENDING because the webhook handler ignores the captured event.
solution_steps: Read logs/payment-webhook.log to identify the actual production event type.
Compare payment.captured in logs with event names handled by src/handlers/paymentWebhook.js.
Update the handler so payment.captured calls orders.markPaid.
Keep duplicate delivery idempotency by relying on the existing markPaid duplicate check.
Confirm unrelated events such as payment.refunded remain ignored.
pitfalls: Do not fix by changing initial order data to PAID.
Do not make all payment.* events mark orders as paid.
Do not remove duplicate delivery checks; production webhooks may be replayed.
